title: New users by first user channel
path: Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > User acquisition
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > User acquisition.
Set the date range to the month the app shows, from its first day to its last.
Make sure the table's first column is the channel group that the first question asks about. If it shows another dimension, choose that one from the drop-down at the top of that column.
Sort the table by the New users column, highest first, by clicking its header.
Read the channel group and the new users in the first channel row below the totals row, then the new users in the totals row at the top of the table.

parts.question: Which first user default channel group brought the most new users in the month?
